answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can actually take. Because the forfeit is priced against the disruption one meadow could cause, a crowd of copies needs a treasury, not a script. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a anchor becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a river.
